001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
004import java.util.EnumMap;
005import java.util.Map;
006import java.util.Objects;
007import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
008import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
009
010import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
011
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.EncoderProvider;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.ContentType;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputType;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5FormatterBuilder;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.JsonFormatterBuilder;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format;
020import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatterBuilder;
021import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LtsvFormatterBuilder;
022import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatterBuilder;
023
024/**
025 * Encoder registry. Only one encoder is registered by default which has the URI schema of
026 * {@value TTLL#SCHEMA} and is used if no encoder is found for the {@link OutputType} of
027 * the resolved output.
028 */
029public sealed interface LogEncoderRegistry extends EncoderProvider {
030
031        /**
032         * Registers an encoder by uri scheme.
033         * @param scheme encoder name.
034         * @param encoder loaded encoder
035         */
036        public void register(String scheme, EncoderProvider encoder);
037
038        /**
039         * Associates a default formatter with a specific output type.
040         * @param outputType output type to use for finding best default formatter.
041         * @return formatter for output type.
042         */
043        public LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> encoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType);
044
045        /**
046         * Sets a default formatter for a specific output type.
047         * @param outputType output type.
048         * @param formatter formatter.
049         */
050        public void setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> formatter);
051
052}
053
054final class DefaultEncoderRegistry implements LogEncoderRegistry {
055
056        /*
057         * The logfmt encoder's URI scheme.
058         */
059        static final String LOGFMT_SCHEME = "logfmt";
060
061        /*
062         * The LTSV encoder's URI scheme.
063         */
064        static final String LTSV_SCHEME = "ltsv";
065
066        /*
067         * The core JSON5 encoder's URI scheme.
068         */
069        static final String JSON5_SCHEME = "json5";
070
071        /*
072         * The core JSON encoder's URI scheme.
073         */
074        static final String JSON_SCHEME = "json";
075
076        private final Map<String, EncoderProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
077
078        /**
079         * Creates encoder registry
080         * @return encoder registry
081         */
082        public static LogEncoderRegistry of() {
083                var registry = new DefaultEncoderRegistry();
084                registry.register(TTLL.SCHEMA,
085                                ref -> (name, config) -> LogEncoder
086                                        .of(ttll(name, config).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref).build())
087                                        .provide(name, config));
088                registry.register(LOGFMT_SCHEME,
089                                ref -> (name, config) -> LogEncoder
090                                        .of(logfmt(name, config).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref).build())
091                                        .provide(name, config));
092                registry.register(LTSV_SCHEME,
093                                ref -> (name, config) -> LogEncoder
094                                        .of(ltsv(name, config).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref).build())
095                                        .provide(name, config));
096                registry.register(JSON5_SCHEME, DefaultEncoderRegistry::json5Encoder);
097                registry.register(JSON_SCHEME,
098                                ref -> (name, config) -> LogEncoder
099                                        .builder(new JsonFormatterBuilder(name).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref).build())
100                                        .contentType(StandardContentType.APPLICATION_JSON)
101                                        .build()
102                                        .provide(name, config));
103                return registry;
104        }
105
106        @Override
107        public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
108                var _ref = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(ref);
109                var uri = _ref.uri();
110                /*
111                 * TODO file bug with checker as it should have found scheme to be null.
112                 */
113                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
114                if (scheme == null) {
115                        throw new IllegalStateException("bug. uri was not normalized");
116                }
117
118                var provider = providers.get(scheme);
119                if (provider == null) {
120                        throw LogProviderRef.NotFoundException.of(ProviderModule.ComponentType.ENCODER, scheme, uri,
121                                        providers.keySet());
122                }
123
124                return provider.provide(_ref);
125        }
126
127        @Override
128        public void register(String scheme, EncoderProvider encoder) {
129                /*
130                 * TODO maybe check if one is already registered and do something?
131                 */
132                providers.put(scheme, encoder);
133        }
134
135        private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
136
137        private final EnumMap<OutputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder>> formatters = new EnumMap<>(OutputType.class);
138
139        /*
140         * Builders for the coloring formatters that honor the global ANSI mode: it sets the
141         * default color mode, while an explicit color property still wins.
142         */
143        static TTLLFormatterBuilder ttll(String name, LogConfig config) {
144                var b = new TTLLFormatterBuilder(name).serviceRegistry(config.serviceRegistry());
145                var color = colorMode(config);
146                if (color != null) {
147                        b.color(color);
148                }
149                return b;
150        }
151
152        static LogfmtFormatterBuilder logfmt(String name, LogConfig config) {
153                var b = new LogfmtFormatterBuilder(name).serviceRegistry(config.serviceRegistry());
154                var color = colorMode(config);
155                if (color != null) {
156                        b.color(color);
157                }
158                return b;
159        }
160
161        static LtsvFormatterBuilder ltsv(String name, LogConfig config) {
162                var b = new LtsvFormatterBuilder(name).serviceRegistry(config.serviceRegistry());
163                var color = colorMode(config);
164                if (color != null) {
165                        b.color(color);
166                }
167                return b;
168        }
169
170        static Json5FormatterBuilder json5(String name, LogConfig config) {
171                var b = new Json5FormatterBuilder(name).serviceRegistry(config.serviceRegistry());
172                var color = colorMode(config);
173                if (color != null) {
174                        b.color(color);
175                }
176                return b;
177        }
178
179        /*
180         * JSON5 has no registered media type, so this uses the one in common use.
181         */
182        static final ContentType JSON5_CONTENT_TYPE = ContentType.of("application/json5", StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
183
184        /*
185         * The content type follows the format property, so a json5 encoder switched to JSON
186         * reports application/json.
187         */
188        private static LogProvider<LogEncoder> json5Encoder(LogProviderRef ref) {
189                return (name, config) -> {
190                        var builder = json5(name, config).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref);
191                        var properties = LogProperties.of(ref.uri(), builder.propertyPrefix(), config.properties(),
192                                        ref.keyOrNull());
193                        var format = properties.forKey(builder.propertyPrefix() + "format")
194                                .ofString()
195                                .map(v -> LogProperty.enumValue(Format.class, v))
196                                .or(Format.JSON5)
197                                .validateNow(Json5FormatterBuilder.class);
198                        var contentType = format == Format.JSON ? StandardContentType.APPLICATION_JSON : JSON5_CONTENT_TYPE;
199                        return LogEncoder.builder(builder.build()).contentType(contentType).build().provide(name, config);
200                };
201        }
202
203        private static TTLL.@Nullable ColorMode colorMode(LogConfig config) {
204                return switch (config.globals().ansiMode()) {
205                        case AUTO -> null;
206                        case ON -> TTLL.ColorMode.FORCE;
207                        case OFF -> TTLL.ColorMode.OFF;
208                };
209        }
210
211        /**
212         * Associates a default formatter with a specific output type
213         * @param outputType output type to use for finding best default formatter.
214         * @return encoder for output type.
215         */
216        @Override
217        public LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> encoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType) {
218                lock.readLock().lock();
219                try {
220                        var formatter = formatters.get(outputType);
221                        if (formatter == null) {
222                                if (outputType == OutputType.CONSOLE_OUT || outputType == OutputType.CONSOLE_ERR) {
223                                        return LogEncoder.ofTTLL();
224                                }
225                                /*
226                                 * Never color a file or other non console output unless asked: ANSI
227                                 * detection only knows about the console.
228                                 */
229                                return (name, config) -> LogEncoder
230                                        .of(ttll(name, config).color(TTLL.ColorMode.OFF).fromProperties(config.properties()).build())
231                                        .provide(name, config);
232                        }
233                        return Objects.requireNonNull(formatter);
234                }
235                finally {
236                        lock.readLock().unlock();
237                }
238        }
239
240        /**
241         * Sets a default formatter for a specific output type.
242         * @param outputType output type.
243         * @param formatter formatter.
244         */
245        @Override
246        public void setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> formatter) {
247                lock.writeLock().lock();
248                try {
249                        formatters.put(outputType, formatter);
250                }
251                finally {
252                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
253                }
254        }
255
256}
